reviews.text: Perfect shade for use as brighting gel liner but also for me to use as concealer! Creamy drying down a bit is perfect. Doesn’t get flaky either when powder used on top. Recommend!
reviews.zh: 呢個色號做提亮 gel liner 一流，我自己仲會用嚟做 concealer！Creamy，乾落去少少就剛剛好。上面再掃粉都唔會起擦。推薦！

reviews.text: 私には鮮やかなオレンジに発色しました。もう少し白みピーチだと思っていたので、残念です😢上手く使いこなせるように研究します。
reviews.zh: 我用落會變成鮮明嘅橙色。本來以為會再白少少、peach 啲，所以有啲失望 😢 會研究下點樣先可以 carry 得到。

reviews.text: Love these liners for my under eye to really open up my eyes. Super creamy and long lasting.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意用呢啲 liner 畫眼底，雙眼即刻望落大啲。超 creamy 又持久。

reviews.text: Such a good udner eye liner to brighten. Creamy and soft but long lasting!
reviews.zh: 用嚟眼底提亮真係一流。Creamy 又軟滑，而且持久！

reviews.text: Purchased because my favorite beauty youtuber really recommended this specific product and color
reviews.zh: 因為我最鍾意嘅美妝 youtuber 極力推薦呢件產品同呢個顏色所以先買。

reviews.text: good shade, I just wanted something to use in my waterline when I want to brighten it up!
reviews.zh: 色號唔錯，我只係想搵枝嘢喺 waterline 想提亮嘅時候用！

reviews.text: Great color and a slim design. It applies smoothly and lasts quite a while.
reviews.zh: 顏色靚，設計纖幼。滑順易推，持久度都幾好。

reviews.text: Omg, it is so soft and easy to use! Just put a little under the eyes and blend with a cotton bud. Natural and fresh-looking!
reviews.zh: 天啊，軟滑到不得了，極易用！喺眼底搽少少再用棉花棒推開就得，自然又有清新感！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
